payload.goal: Generate a single de novo soluble protein candidate, analyze its sequence and structure, perform QC, and rank the result.
assumptions: A Protenix-format input JSON describing a small soluble target is available at a known path.
The generated sequence will be analyzed using the first generated structure.

missing_inputs.name: input_json
missing_inputs.reason: Required path to the Protenix-format input JSON describing the molecular system for structure generation.

missing_inputs.name: pdb_path
missing_inputs.reason: Required path to the PDB file of the generated structure for sequence analysis and QC.

nodes.intent: Generate a single de novo 3D structure candidate from the input specification.
Analyze the sequence of the generated candidate for composition, charge, and liabilities.
Perform per-residue structural analysis (exposure, contacts, liabilities) on the generated candidate.
Run quality control checks (pI, GRAVY, etc.) on the generated candidate sequence.
Aggregate sequence analysis, structure analysis, and QC results to rank the single candidate.

finalization.ranking_preference: prioritize candidates with favorable sequence properties (low GRAVY, neutral pI) and high structural confidence (high pLDDT if available) and low liability scores.

nodes.intent: Generate a ranked list of amino-acid sequences for the fixed backbone template.
Perform sequence-level analysis (composition, charge, motifs) on the generated candidate.
Perform per-residue structural analysis (exposure, contacts, liabilities) on the generated candidate.
Run quality control checks (pI, GRAVY, polybasic regions) on the generated candidate.
Aggregate sequence analysis, structure analysis, and QC results to rank the single candidate.

finalization.ranking_preference: prioritize candidates with favorable sequence properties (low GRAVY, neutral pI) and high structural stability indicators.
